newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.7 pct - banking survey.
newsitem.headline: Polish 1997 CPI seen at 16.7 pct - banking survey.

text.p: Polish bankers expected year-on-year inflation at 16.7 percent in December 1997 compared with 16.6 percent in March, a monthly poll released on Wednesday by the private Pentor intitute showed.
Last month Pentor's poll, conducted among over 200 bank managers, showed inflation at 16.8 percent at the end of 1997.
A Reuter poll done last week showed year-end inflation at 15.73 percent.
Pentor's poll showed that the zloty was expected to fall at end-1997 to 3.31 to the U.S. dollar.
The zloty was fixed at 3.1195 to the dollar on Wednesday.
According to the Reuter poll the zloty was seen at 3.3817 to the dollar by the end of the year.
